repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

main.description: The accounts a repository names in its record as its runners, as `knotless runner list` lists them: those whose checks of it are shown, and who land its merge queue. No authentication; responses are not personalized.

keys.description: The key each runner publishes in its dev.knotless.runnerKey record, for its owner to seal secrets to, as dev.knotless.putSecret takes them; a runner that publishes none is not here.

minutes.description: The minutes each runner counts for the repository's owner, where it has counted any; none for a private repository.

warning.description: After adding a runner to a private repository, why it could not be told of it: adding it again tells it again.

runners.description: A repository's runners, in the order its record names them.

runnerKey.description: The key one runner publishes to seal its secrets to.
